title: Business English Conversation 9:  Emergency Business Trip
content: 1. headquarters: the main office of a large corporation - Our company headquarters is located in Seattle. - I don't know where their headquarters are located. 2. a direct flight: a flight that goes directly to its destination without making any stops - Direct flights are the best because they are the shortest. - I like direct flights because I don't like changing planes. 3. a layover: a period of time when one gets off one plane, but has to wait in the airport before one's next flight leaves - I was going from Seoul to LA, but I had a 4-hour layover in Tokyo. - On my flight from London to Sydney, there was a 5-hour layover in Dubai.
